main_body: A slot machine cabinet: gold crown/header at top, crimson body with a reel window (white/red/yellow symbols between black dividers), a coin tray and a dark payout slot, then a gold/brown base. Everything is drawn as a straight-on face.
top_band: Rows 1-4 gold (#d5b152) read as the header sign panel, not a horizontal top surface. Row 4 has a pale highlight, followed by a dark brown band at rows 5-8. This is a vertical marquee face, not a top.
evidence: The column at x=9 goes from a gold header (rows 1-4) to a dark brown band (5-8), then a crimson face with the reel window, tray and slot, then a gold base. Nothing in it is a horizontal surface seen from above. The gold crown is a vertical sign panel, the same as the cabinet face in the red 'front elevation' example in the guide. The reel window and slot are inset, but the whole machine is a flat front view with no top band, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has 12 distinct colours and a median of 12 per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references, so it is lower in density. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, which is good. The outlines are mostly tinted dark brown and dark crimson, with only 17% neutral edge pixels, so they read as material tones rather than a black sticker line. It has about 4 steps on the crimson and gold ramps. The reel symbols add variety, but the large crimson and brown areas are fairly smooth and lack the grain and per-element shading of the references. It looks a bit thinner than the references, though not sticker-like.
